reviews.author: Love It!

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.body: I originally bought this for a 27 inch monitor. It held it up perfectly fine but the monitor was too large for the space. So I purchased a 21 inch monitor for it instead. So I know it can hold up a pretty heavy old monitor just fine if needed. It looks great on my desk. I like that it has a way to organize cables as well. I have very limited desk space and still wanted to use a laptop as well as a pc. So anytime I want to use my laptop I can easily push my monitor out of the way and adjust it to any angle or height. I will say it was a little difficult to adjust the tension in the arm. But other than it being a little stiff it’s fine.

reviews.title: Must get
reviews.body: I recently got a monitor arm, and it’s transformed the way I use my desk — in a good way. It’s sturdy and holds my monitor firmly in place, yet it’s flexible enough to adjust height, tilt, and angle depending on what I’m doing (gaming, studying, or editing photos). That adjustability makes a big difference for comfort: I no longer crane my neck or hunch over, and it’s easier to line up the screen just right.

reviews.body: Probably the utmost PAINSTAKING and INCOMPATIBLE experience I have ever had in my life with any object, and I can assure you that I am not exaggerating. All around I have never written a review in my life but do not buy this at all.

features: Universal Single Monitor Arm: The Freelift Pro monitor arm is designed to most 22 - 32 inch flat or curved monitors, holding 4.4 - 22 lbs screens. With VESA patterns 75x75mm and 100x100mm, compatible with Samsung, ASUS, Acer, LG, HP, AOC, Dell, Sceptre, etc. It is perfect for anyone seeking a sturdy and reliable full motion monitor mount for workspace.

Full Motion Single Monitor Desk Mount: Our monitor stand allows the screen to tilt up 85° down -45°, swivel 180°, and rotate 360° from landscape to portrait. Each connection of the arm is adjustable. The arm can extend up to 21" long, and rise up to 17.3" height. You'll be able to set your screen where you want it. Freelift monitor arm can easily adjust to the best position that suits your sitting or standing style, allowing you to find the perfect viewing angle whether you're gaming or working.

Saving More Space: The single monitor mount tested 20,000 times to ensure long-lasting performance for your workspace. Also, the integrated cable management concealed wires within arms and keeps your wires organized. Save over 80% of your desk space for a more tidy and comfortable working, gaming, or entertaining environment.

Two Installation Methods: This monitor stand for desk comes with both C-clamp and grommet base. Choose C-clamp mounting for desks with 0.39″ to 2.76″ thickness or the grommet mounting fits the desk 0.39" - 2.76" thickness with a bolt-through hole 0.39" - 2.36". If the thickness of your desk is not within this range, please relate with us for suitable C-clamp.

Special Designs: Compared to a computer monitor stand with the normal VESA plate, our single monitor arm uses quick release VESA plate. It can easily lock the monitor. No gaps, no wobbling. Otherwise, the lower arm can conveniently store Allen Keys for your future use.
